name: Mai Sex
source:
One night, our main character sneaks into the room of his sleeping little sister Yui for a bit of fun...once you stray from the path, there's no going back.

This is an incestual story that unfolds in a love nest. Their love story is one which cannot be forgiven by anyone.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041793.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某夜，主人公偷偷溜进熟睡的妹妹由衣房间，想找点乐子……一旦偏离正道，就再也回不了头。

这是一个发生在爱巢中的禁忌乱伦故事。他们的爱情无人能够原谅。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041793.html]DLsite English[/url]）
